_comment: Per-depth L1 retention for scripts/precompute_l1_tree.py (the offline bottom-up L1-tree cache build). root = depth 0. Shallow interior nodes summarize huge subtrees so they keep more; deep leaf-adjacent nodes summarize little and compress hard. 'default' applies to any unlisted depth. Used by the path-selective recursive-L1 runs (KILT / pubmedqa / narrativeqa).
